headline.question: Is there a physically plausible operating window?
headline.notes: A computationally plausible window exists at moderate temperature (approximately 45-70 C) with latent ROMP and phi~0.1-0.2. At 150 C, published Ru/phosphite gel times extrapolate far below 25 min (FAIL). Mechanical strength at 150 C is near Tg and remains UNKNOWN.
